storyTitle: Verify Balance and Apply Statement Credit
oneSentenceStory: The customer verifies their current LBG coin balance and cashback metrics to apply funds directly as a practical statement credit.
customerSituation: Customer has accumulated 7,300 LBG coins and wants to check their exact cashback value before reducing bill payments.
storyTension: Ensuring the redemption process is transparent, straightforward, and free from complicated lifestyle partner distractions.
customerResolution: Customer views clear points and cashback metrics, executing a seamless statement credit redemption toward linked card bills.
primaryOutcome: Effortless verification of tangible cashback value and direct statement credit application.
completionSignals: User interacts with statement credit option
